objective: Compare the temporal behavior of the active Add Noise, Film Grunge, and Match Grain grain equations on a static source after calibrating their initial green-channel residual strength to the same target.

effects: Match Grain default luma/chroma transfer and temporal jitter
scope.method: Independent Python/NumPy/OpenCV source-equation models; no Artifact execution. Use a 28x28 opaque neutral .5 source, 128 integer frame keys, and one fixed deterministic synthetic multiscale reference for Match Grain.
included: frame-to-frame spatial correlation and delta RMSE
RGB channel correlation at frame zero
excluded: Core NoiseType::FilmGrain and legacy FilmEffectProcessor (no active production consumer found)

comparison.baseline: Film Grunge grain term with source default grainAmount=.075 and grainSize=1.4 (rounds to one pixel); all other effect contributions disabled in the isolated model.
candidates: Add Noise color mode at Size=1 and seed=1977, Amount solved to match Film Grunge frame-zero centered green residual stddev
Match Grain grainSize=1.15, default luma/chroma/shadow/highlight/jitter controls and fixed reference, Amount solved to match the same frame-zero centered green residual stddev
frame keys 0..127 inclusive for all three effects
comparison.ground_truth: None. RMS matching is a calibration convention only; the synthetic reference and equations do not establish a preferred look or temporal quality target.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive only. Verify source markers, deterministic frame access, finite outputs, zero-amount/neutral assumptions where applicable, exact Add Noise field hold, and report temporal metrics. No pass threshold for perceived flicker.

materials.fixture: Generated locally: opaque neutral source at RGB=.5; fixed 28x28 three-channel synthetic multi-scale texture for Match Grain; no external material.
materials.identity: Record plan/source/runner hashes, synthetic reference residual hash, library versions, seeds, dimensions, settings, and output checksums.

regions.whole: All 28x28 pixels; per-frame mean-center residual fields for temporal correlation and standard deviation.

conditions.coordinate_safety: For Film Grunge x,y<=27 and block=1, coordinate products 27*73856093 and 27*19349663 remain within signed int32; no overflow assumptions are needed.

film_grunge.other_contributions: isolated to zero; only the grain term is modeled

add_noise.amount: calibrated to Film Grunge initial centered green residual stddev

match_grain.amount: calibrated to Film Grunge initial centered green residual stddev

metrics: per-effect calibrated Amount and initial per-channel standard deviation
adjacent-frame spatial luma correlation and delta RMSE, raw and normalized by target stddev
pooled per-pixel temporal autocorrelation at lag 1 and lag 4 after temporal-mean removal
per-pixel temporal variance and unique frame fields
conditions.display: Three rows (one per effect) by frames 0..5; common 4x residual gain on neutral .5 plate. Metrics use Float32 equation outputs before display conversion.

effect_correctness.method: Check each isolated grain equation, seeds, per-frame key and source markers; verify Add Noise is time invariant and Match Grain is a pure cyclic shift of its fixed residual field.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Markers agree; exact deterministic regeneration; source model outputs finite; zero-amount neutral identity where modeled.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect fixed frame contact sheet and per-frame residual statistics.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic judgment, matched-appearance claim, or temporal-quality verdict.

color_and_alpha.method: Report RGB channel correlations and range at source=.5; alpha is source-preserved by source contract.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Colored content, alpha edges/association, transfer function, display transform, real reference import.

temporal_stability.method: Static source, fixed settings and 128 composition-frame keys; compare unaligned and known-offset-aligned residuals.
temporal_stability.unverified: Real playback, motion, dropped frames, seek/reverse, viewer perception.

render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Compiled CPU/GPU outputs, production size behavior, preview/final parity.

evaluation.decision: No effect preference, preset recommendation, quality acceptance or product integration approval.

execution.backend: Python 3, NumPy, OpenCV, Pillow; offline source-equation models only.
execution.threshold_policy: Only exact model invariants are checked; no perceptual threshold.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed source/reference seeds, frame keys, sizes, amount calibration, source hashes and SHA-256 manifests.

amendments.reason: A comparability review found that the planned lag-4 value was implemented as a median spatial correlation across frame pairs, while the existing Film Grunge temporal study reports a pooled per-pixel time autocorrelation.
amendments.change: Retain adjacent-frame spatial correlation and add pooled per-pixel temporal autocorrelation at lags 1 and 4, with each pixel's temporal mean removed.
amendments.scope_effect: Adds a separately named temporal metric for cross-study interpretation; candidate settings, calibration, conditions, and acceptance criteria are unchanged. Regenerate the complete report.
